mathematical_claims.anchor: an element has minimal-polynomial degree d exactly when its Frobenius orbit has length d.

description: Uses Frobenius orbits to characterize finite-field subfields and minimal polynomials, counts irreducibles by Möbius inversion, proves Rabin’s irreducibility criterion, and introduces finite-field trace and norm.
